pages.observed: Five samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of an airport pickup curb. A white sensor-roof car sits at the far left edge beside an empty pickup bay outline; phone card reads Ride requested. Caption box appears at 0.6 s over the road.

1.0 to 1.8 s: the white roof-pod car glides right into the painted pickup bay with a red brake glow at its rear and settles in the bay. Caption box sits just under the car over the road; phone card still reads Ride requested.

2.0 to 2.2 s car sits in the bay; Texas locator card appears top right. At 2.4 s cut to an interior view behind two empty seats looking through the windshield at the airport pickup sign; steering wheel with a top marker shows only a small rotation through 2.8 s. Phone card and caption overlay the cab.

3.0 to 3.8 s cab interior: the steering wheel rotates with no hands, its tan rim marker moving clockwise to the right side with a light arc trail, while the airport sign slides out the right of the windshield. Both front seats are empty seat backs. Texas outline card draws in top right.

4.0 to 4.6 s cab view holds with the wheel turned; caption clears at 4.6 s. At 4.8 s cut to the curb: a large tilted phone reading Ride requested, Finding a car stands in front of the white car parked in its bay under the airport sign. No caption at 4.8 s.

5.0 to 5.8 s: phone in front of the parked car; the car pin slides down the route to the destination and at 5.6 s the label flips from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb. Caption the airport included. sits below the curb line, clear of car and phone. Texas card rings a point.

6.0 to 6.6 s curb hold: phone reads Arriving, At the curb, with the car pin at the destination and the car parked; caption clears after 6.0 s. At 6.8 s cut to a wooden table holding a pale gridded map sheet with a few small pin markers and a standing card labelled February.

7.0 to 7.8 s medium view of a pale map on a wooden table with a blank February card behind it. Map shows only faint grid and three tiny pins; a thin blue river line and faint street strokes start drawing at 7.6 to 7.8 s. Caption The service began in February sits below the map on the table.

8.0 to 8.8 s: on the table map a blue river line extends down through the sheet and faint grey roads and a ring arc draw in; three small pins sit near center. The February card stays blank. Texas locator card fades out. Caption The service began in February unchanged.

9.0 s medium map, then at 9.2 s a closer map with river, roads and a center street cluster, no caption. From 9.4 s a tag 60 square miles, Limited area appears near the top, a dark outline begins tracing from it, and the February card slides in from the right and lands on the lower left of the map by 9.8 s.

10.0 to 10.8 s: a dark outline traces around the central street cluster and closes at 10.8 s into a shaded polygon enclosing the three car pins, beneath the 60 square miles, Limited area tag; the February card rests at lower left. Caption sits below the map.

11.0 to 11.8 s: the closed shaded service polygon holds on the map under the 60 square miles, Limited area tag, with the February card at lower left; the three small car pins move slightly within the outline. Caption unchanged below the map.

12.0 to 12.2 s the map polygon holds without caption. At 12.4 s cut to an overhead view: a brown band with pale streaks crosses the frame above a tan bank and green ground with two round tree canopies; a white car seen from above, its cabin showing two empty seats and a round roof pod, sits at the band's lower edge with pale puffs at its right end. Disclosure changes to A different car, April 20th account. Caption at 12.8 s sits directly under the car.

13.0 to 13.8 s overhead creek view: the white car sits at the lower edge of the brown band against the tan bank with pale puffs at its right end; streaks in the brown band shift slightly and the car moves only a small amount up and left by 13.8 s. Caption sits just below the car, above the tree canopies.

14.0 to 14.6 s the car tilts a few degrees and slides slightly left along the edge of the brown band, still mostly at the tan bank. At 14.8 s a cut to a higher overhead framing shows the band with a small tree and pale ledge on the far bank and the car now at the right side of frame. Caption stays below the car.

15.0 to 15.8 s: the white car with empty seats turns diagonally, grows larger as if lifted, moves out into the middle of the brown band with a foam bulge and wake lines on its upstream side, and drifts left until it is partly out of frame at 15.8 s. Caption remains below, clear of the car.

16.0 to 16.4 s the car and its foam leave the frame on the left edge of the brown creek band; by 16.6 s the creek is empty of the car and the caption has cleared. The frame holds the empty current through 16.8 s.

17.0 to 17.2 s the empty creek holds with no caption. At 17.4 s cut to a street: a tan house, a spreading tree and green street signs behind a brown water band where a white roof-pod car stands with its reflection; a dark grey rounded shape sits at the right edge of the water. Disclosure reads Another car, earlier in April. Caption appears at 17.6 s under the car.

18.0 to 18.8 s wide street: the white car eases a little to the right in the brown water and stops while the water line climbs from the hubs to cover the wheels and lower doors. Car occupies a small band in the middle of a tall frame; caption sits just below the water band.

19.0 to 19.6 s the car is stopped with water over the wheels; a small amber lamp glow blinks at its front right at 19.2 to 19.4 s. At 19.8 s cut closer: the car side view is larger, water reaches the lower doors and reflects the car, background softened. Caption below the water.

20.0 to 20.8 s closer view: the stopped white car sits in brown water over its wheels, amber lamps glowing at front and rear corners in an on and off pattern; through the side windows only seat headrests are visible, no occupant. Caption sits under the reflection.

21.0 to 21.8 s the stopped car holds in the brown water with amber lamps blinking on and off; the cabin windows show only empty headrests. Caption clears after 21.2 s and the shot holds uncaptioned to 21.8 s.

22.0 s last street frame, then at 22.2 s cut to a tilted cream card on a brown desk against an olive wall, reading Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall, with a pen tip at lower right; the card is cut off by the right frame edge and slides slightly left. Caption at 22.6 s sits over the lower left corner of the card.

23.0 to 23.8 s the record card settles fully on the desk and its rows write in: Recall type, Software, then Potential units affected, 3,791, with a cursor following the text and the pen tip resting at lower right. Caption sits just below the card.

24.0 to 24.6 s the completed record card holds on the desk; the caption clears at 24.6 s. At 24.8 s a closer view shows the card above a grid of empty car-outline slots, with the first two white car icons filled at top left; new caption under the grid.

25.0 to 25.8 s: the grid of car icons fills row by row until fifty icons are shown, while a hand in a blue sleeve brings a wooden rubber stamp in from the right and holds it over the card's upper area with a shadow beneath. Caption sits under the grid.

26.0 to 26.8 s: the hand presses the stamp onto the card and lifts it, leaving an amber Software recall mark at upper right; a pinned tag fades in and settles reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record, above the full car-icon grid. Caption remains under the grid.

27.0 to 27.8 s: the stamped record card, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full icon grid hold as the stamp hand exits right; the caption clears after 27.4 s and the completed result holds uncaptioned to 27.8 s.

28.0 s record desk, then at 28.2 s cut to a wide road with a dashed lane line, barrier, lamp and skyline; the white car enters from the left and travels right. A quote card fades in at top left by 28.8 s reading the recall sentence. No standing water is visible on the lane in these samples. Caption sits along the road's lower edge just under the car.

29.0 to 29.8 s: the camera tracks the white car along the road; the car stays near left center with motion streaks while dashes and skyline scroll past. The quote card holds at top. No water and no lit brake lamp are visible yet. Caption under the car along the road edge.

30.0 to 30.8 s: a pale grey lens-shaped patch of standing water appears on the lane at the right edge while the white car, rear brake lamp glowing red, closes toward it. The water patch's lower edge sits just above the caption box at right.

31.0 to 31.4 s the car creeps right toward the grey water patch with no lit brake lamp visible; at 31.6 s cut to a close side view of the car occupying the frame width, a pale wavy line beneath its wheels and the edge of the water just entering at right by 31.8 s. Caption changes to then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

32.0 to 32.8 s close side view: a pale grey patch of standing water slides in from the right until the car's front wheel meets its edge; at 32.8 s the word may in the quote card above lights amber. Caption sits under the road edge, clear of the wheels.

33.0 to 33.8 s: the car rolls forward into the standing water; the grey water now spreads under the front wheel and body with reflected streaks and wake lines at the wheel, while may stays highlighted amber in the quote card. Caption under the road edge.

34.0 to 34.8 s: the car is in the standing water with a fan of wake lines and its reflection under the body; the roadside tree and a lamp pole slide past behind, showing continued travel. The amber may highlight holds in the quote card. Wake bottom sits just above the caption.

35.0 to 35.4 s the car holds in the standing water with its wake, uncaptioned. At 35.6 s cut to the record card on the desk, larger, with the Software recall stamp and an empty lower section; at 35.8 s the caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development appears under the card.

36.0 to 36.8 s: a Remedy row wipes onto the record card with a pale amber highlight, reading The remedy is currently under development. by 36.4 s; a pen tip held by fingers slides in from the right toward the row. Caption below the card on the desk.

37.0 to 37.6 s a hand in a blue sleeve rests a pen tip at the end of the highlighted remedy text. At 37.8 s a closer card view adds a second blue-sleeved arm from the lower right holding a wooden stamp over the lower part of the remedy row, while the pen hand stays. Caption under the card.

38.0 to 38.8 s close card: a blue-sleeved hand presses a wooden stamp on the lower remedy area while the other hand holds the pen at the remedy text; at 38.8 s the stamp starts to lift and slide right, revealing an amber mark beginning Und. Caption under the card.

39.0 to 39.8 s: an amber Under development stamp mark now sits in the remedy row beneath the highlighted text; the stamp arm and the pen hand withdraw toward the lower right and right. The caption clears after 39.2 s; the stamped card holds uncaptioned.

40.0 to 40.8 s: a new shot of four white roof-pod cars parked in a diagonal row on wet pavement under an overhead wire carrying a small Vehicle maps card and a blank April calendar card. From 40.4 s a Weather limits, tightened tag slides in from the left edge, its first letters clipped by the frame until 40.8 s. No cloud or rain icon is readable at this size. Caption below the front car.

41.0 to 41.8 s: the Weather limits, tightened tag, now fully in frame with a small cloud and rain icon, slides along the overhead wire toward center and settles above the row of four parked white cars. The Vehicle maps card and a blank April card hang at right. Caption below the front car.

42.0 to 42.8 s: the composition holds with the Weather limits tag swaying slightly on the wire above the four parked cars; the April card is still blank and no car has a check mark. Caption unchanged below the front car.

43.0 to 43.4 s the wide car row holds. At 43.6 s cut closer: a large white car in profile leads a row of cars receding right, under a larger Weather limits, tightened tag with a cloud and rain icon, a Vehicle maps card and a still blank April card. New caption at 43.8 s sits under the front car's wheels.

44.0 to 44.8 s: round check-mark badges draw in above each car in turn from the front car back along the row, left to right; a small ring appears on the Vehicle maps card. The April card remains blank. Caption under the front car.

45.0 to 45.8 s: all four cars carry check-mark badges and the Vehicle maps card gains its own check mark at 45.2 s with a tiny second line; the composition then holds. The April card still shows only its header and a blank page. Caption under the front car.

46.0 to 46.8 s: the April calendar card at the right edge flips its page at 46.2 to 46.4 s to show a large 20, while all four cars keep their check-mark badges under the Weather limits tag. The calendar sits close to the right frame edge. Caption under the front car.

47.0 to 47.6 s the completed result holds: every car checked, April 20 shown; caption clears after 47.0 s. At 47.8 s cut back to the airport curb: the white car sits in the painted bay under the plane-and-car pickup sign, a phone card at upper left reads Arriving, and the disclosure reads A generic airport ride, not the flood cars.

48.0 to 48.8 s at the airport curb: the white car waits in the bay and its rear door swings open from 48.4 s, standing open with a dark doorway by 48.8 s. The phone card reads Arriving, At the curb. Caption sits on the road below the car.
49.0 to 49.8 s the curb shot holds: the white car sits in the bay with its rear door open and a light seat visible inside, phone reads Arriving. Caption clears after 49.6 s.

50.0 to 50.8 s closer curb view: the white car waits in the bay with its rear door open, a small phone rests on the bench, and a small tilted record card floats over the road in the foreground reading The remedy is currently under development with a small amber stamp; the card text is small relative to the frame. Caption under the card from 50.2 s.

51.0 to 51.8 s: the record card grows in the foreground over the road until its highlighted remedy row The remedy is currently under development and its Under development stamp are readable, its top edge meeting the car's wheels; the car waits behind with its door open. Caption sits just below the card.

52.0 to 52.8 s: the open-door car and the foreground record card hold together; the card's top edge abuts the bottom of the car's wheels. The caption changes after a short gap to as currently under development at 52.8 s.

53.0 to 53.8 s: a split frame shows the open-door car at the airport curb above and, on a desk below, the record card beside a small phone with the ride route; an underline draws under under development on the card. Caption sits on the desk below the card.

54.0 to 54.8 s: the split closing image holds, open-door car at the curb above and the record card with its underlined under development row and stamp beside the small phone below; the caption clears after 54.0 s, leaving a large empty desk area in the lower part of the frame.

55.0 to 55.8 s: the closing split image holds uncaptioned, the open-door car waiting at the curb above and the record card reading The remedy is currently under development with its stamp and the small ride phone below; the bottom half of the frame is empty desk.

56.0 to 56.8 s: a dark credits card fades up with a Lone Star flag icon, the Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, and source, illustration, map and music credits including Waymo, October 14th, NHTSA recall 26E026 and Texas Public Radio, May 10th and 13th. The small credit text is legible but tiny at phone size.
57.0 to 57.8 s: the credits card holds unchanged: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, and the sources, illustration, map and music credit block.
58.0 to 58.8 s: the same credits card holds unchanged with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and the full source and music credit block.
59.0 to 59.8 s: the credits card continues to hold unchanged with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the sources, illustration, map and music credits.
60.0 to 60.8 s: the credits card holds unchanged with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and the sources, illustration, map and music credit block.

Final phone frame 1829 at 60.967 s: the credits card is unchanged, showing the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, and the sources, illustration, map and music credits; no black or missing frame at the end.
